name: web-presentations
description: Create, refine, and package polished interactive web presentations as portable ZIP files.

interface.shortDescription: Create interactive presentations for the web.
interface.longDescription: Create, refine, and iteratively edit web presentations from natural-language prompts. Improve typography, web-native diagrams, spacing, and interaction design while preserving the existing shell. Every new deck uses a shared two-axis navigation shell and packages to a portable ZIP containing index.html and local assets.
defaultPrompt: Add a sub-slide to this presentation.
Package this presentation as a ZIP.
Refine this presentation’s typography, diagrams, spacing, and user experience without changing its shell.
